effect.name: MLG Foilage (Switch)
effect.description: This shader creates a rainbow gradient effect based on the texture's luminance, just like the MLG images (RIP eyes).
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo MLG Foilage (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.29 */
parameter.description: This shader creates a rainbow gradient effect based on the texture's luminance, just like the MLG images (RIP eyes).

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 0 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 1 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Add Offset
parameter.description: This variable defines the offset of the sine wave.

parameter.name: Multiply Phase
parameter.description: This variable defines the frequency of a sine wave.
